title: Maikura Blessings
description: Gain permanent character bonuses through advancement-based progression.
body:
# Maikura Blessings

Gain permanent blessings by completing advancements.

Maikura Blessings rewards player progression with permanent character bonuses. As you complete advancements throughout your world, your character gradually becomes stronger, faster, and more resilient.

Designed for long-term survival gameplay without requiring additional grinding systems.

## Features

### Advancement-Based Progression

Complete advancements to earn permanent blessing bonuses.

### Permanent Character Growth

Increase:

- Maximum Health
- Attack Power
- Movement Speed
- Mining Speed
- Hunger Efficiency
- Fall Damage Resistance
- Fire Resistance
- Projectile Resistance
- Underwater Performance
- Potion Effect Strength
- Experience Gain

### Progress Tracking

Track registered and uncompleted advancements through built-in commands.

### Multiplayer Friendly

Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11
- Fabric API
- Multiplayer Supported
